entries.purpose: scientist holding a big glossy arrow (loading / splash pose)
entries.notes: r3 (2026-09-25, characters lane): rebuilt as the 'load' pose + style on store 8 / V1 measured about the eye line (90 pt/u): squat WIDE torso (x 1.05 / y 0.90) whose shoulders rise to the cheeks, centred right of the face; the fist a clenched ball beside the mouth (forearm from a rolled cuff); the other mitt gripping an orange (up-left) + red (left) arrow at the right side; the far leg kicked back; head turned 16 deg left with a taller, fuller dome (skin rows within ~5 pt of theirs), raised thinner brows, a CRESCENT smile with a small two-tooth band (16 x 5 pt vs their 19 x 5), fur ladder lifted (median S 0.67 V 0.81 vs theirs 0.67 / 0.82; hue kept PINK); camera pitch +5 (seen from a little above like store 8). Layout (49.66, 224.34) by the eye whites (target biased 3.5 pt left / 3 pt down). Left: the mouth still reads a little more open than theirs; no notched lapel.
